problem_statement: The border agent ephemeral-key mechanism is exposed over the NCP/Spinel interface but cannot be driven: the Spinel property keys used to enable the feature, to activate the ephemeral-key mode (with a PSKc, a timeout and a UDP port), and to deactivate it are not defined, and no NCP property set/get handlers exist for them. A host sending PROP_VALUE_SET frames for these keys gets an unknown/unsupported property instead of the enable/activate/deactivate being honored, and the border agent ephemeral-key state (Disabled/Stopped/Started) cannot be queried. The interface must accept these set requests and reflect the resulting state.
